text:
omar: Quick follow-up from postmortem Two canaries tripped this week. We need a compact set of guardrails: stricter initial gate, explicit auto-rollback semantics, and clear owners for each remediation.

lucy: Agree. Propose a "gatekeeper" approach: require three independent signals to progress. Also add a hard cap on total canary traffic.

sam: Concrete suggestion: initial gate 0.25% traffic for 5m hold. Progress only if: (1) error_rate <= baseline +3pp, (2) p95 latency <= baseline +150ms, (3) schema/malformed_rate <= 0.1%. If any fails, auto-rollback. Global max canary 2.5%.

mira: I like the three-signal requirement. Who owns what? I'll take runbooks and dashboards. Omar take rollout config + infra. Sam take rollback rule implementation and smoke harness.

omar: I'll draft the config and a small gatekeeper controller to evaluate the three signals atomically. Will create INF-7007 and link PRs. ETA: config PR by Tue EOD, rule impl Wed.

sam: small note: keep windows consistent. Using a 5m hold for the initial batch and 3m eval windows for metrics gives better signal stability. I'll implement default windows and make them configurable per rollout.

lucy: Add pre-rollout model checks: tokenizer compatibility, model checksum match, and disallow model swap during a rollout. Also mandatory model-diff on a canary traffic slice.

mira: I'll add paging rules: sev2 or higher triggers pager; sev3 stays in slack. I'll add a short on-call snippet for interpretating gatekeeper decisions and how to manually override if needed.

dev-bot: INF-7007 created by @omar. Canary plan queued: gatekeeper/v1 scheduled 2026-11-12 01:00 UTC.

omar: Draft gatekeeper config (to be committed):
```
gatekeeper:
  initial_gate: 0.25%
  hold_time: 5m
  progression: [1%, 5%, 20%]
  max_total_canary: 2.5%
  required_signals: [error_rate, p95_latency, schema_ok]
  rollback_on_failure: true
  signal_thresholds:
    error_rate: +0.03
    p95_latency_ms: +150
    schema_fail_rate: 0.001
  eval_window: 3m
```

sam: I'll add a smoke harness that runs golden prompts + schema checks after each gate. If smoke fails, gatekeeper triggers rollback and creates INF-7007-rollback alert.

lucy: Also adding a note to INF-7007: review recurring pattern table. Last 6 incidents show tokenizer mismatches and unannounced model swaps as root causes. This justifies the no-swap policy.

omar: Creating a recurring "Gatekeeper Review" every quarter to revisit the three-signal thresholds and canary caps. We'll log adjustments in the ticket.

mira: Once PRs reference INF-7007 and runbook is in place, we can consider relaxing the initial gate to 0.5% for low-risk internal tests. For external prod rollouts keep conservative defaults.

sam: All action items in INF-7007: owners and deadlines included. I'll tag the PRs and add test results when ready. :thumbsup:
